thread:
sam.finance: Heads-up: ClinicalAI submitted a billing discrepancy. Invoice INV-5345 lists a 4-GPU reserved commit for June but metering shows zero committed hours; they were billed full burst. They want correction for their auditors.
indra.ops: Can you attach the invoice + provisioning audit?
billing-bot: Invoice INV-5345 uploaded: https://invoices.redwood/INV-5345.pdf
billing-bot: Metering snippet: committed_hours=0, burst_tokens=3,420,150, reserved_tag=missing, tag_intent=applied-2026-06-03T03:12:10Z, billing_snapshot=2026-06-03T03:00:00Z
michael.sales: Sales notes: Contract CLIN-4G-2026 had reserved start 2026-06-01. Onboarding flow shows a manual step to finalize pool mapping; looks like that final click didn't happen.
sam.finance: Quick numbers: burst billed $21,600, reserved expected $12,000, delta $9,600. If we retro-allocate reserved and reissue invoice, refund would be $9,600. Alternative: one-time operational SLA credit. We need z.s approval.
zoe.revenue: If customer requests corrected invoice for audit, we should do it, but it requires legal sign-off for reissue. For quick resolution, approve goodwill credit up to $11,000 to include buffer. Need ops confirmation of root cause and fix.
indra.ops: Root cause: UI onboarding step failed due to a race on the finalization webhook; we've got a patch ready. We'll run the audit query and paste rows.
indra.ops: Query:
```
SELECT customer_id, event_time, reserved_tag_state
FROM provisioning.audit
WHERE customer_id='cust_clinicalai' AND date(event_time) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-04';
```
indra.ops: Output: customer_id=cust_clinicalai, event_time=2026-06-03T03:12:10Z, reserved_tag_state=applied_pending; billing_snapshot_time=2026-06-03T03:00:00Z
michael.sales: Customer message: "We expect reserved commit to have been active from the start of June as per contract. Please advise asap; auditors on the line."
sam.finance: Zoe, we need an explicit "approve" to book an operational credit. Also ops to commit PR and add runbook.
zoe.revenue: approve
sam.finance: Creating ledger adjustment ADJ-2026-399 | amount: -11000 | reason: operational_goodwill_credit | linked_invoice: INV-5345. Finance to attach note: "Issued as one-time operational goodwill credit due to provisioning onboarding race; customer notified."
billing-bot: Ledger entry created: ADJ-2026-399 | customer: cust_clinicalai | amount: -11000 | reason: operational_goodwill_credit | linked_invoice: INV-5345
indra.ops: Patch merged, webhook retry logic added, runbook entry created: https://runbooks.redwood/onboarding-webhook-race. Will post postmortem.
michael.sales: I'll send the customer the credit confirmation and attach ledger note for auditors. Draft: "We found a provisioning onboarding race that prevented your reserved commit from binding for June; we've applied a one-time operational credit of $11,000 and fixed the issue. Please see attached ledger note for your records."
sam.finance: Closing loop. Finance booked ADJ-2026-399, CS notified customer, ops to post incident note. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
